stage1.impression: Two red-glowing acrylic speakers on pale oak plinths against a gridded wall of tiles with a mottled camouflage pattern. The floor, which is most of the bottom third, sinks into murky oxblood-black, and there are no chairs, tables, lamps or any sign of life. It reads as a CG showroom or a nightclub speaker display. At 1:1 the wall is a procedural cell pattern under a grid, the timber is flat, and the cabinet edges glow neon-flat. A magazine would not run it as a specific place: it shows a product plinth, not a listening room.

blocking_9: The frame must show the listening zone it is for: oxblood tub chairs and hex tables with lit Orbs in the foreground, facing the altar, with the carpet reading as wool and not as black void
The end-grain niche must read as real oak end-grain blocks (rings, checks, per-block tone), not a Voronoi camouflage texture under a grid

The speakers must be lit as objects (front faces, horns and plinths read by the room's light) rather than outlined only by their own flat neon glow; horn region lum_median >= 35, speaker clip_pct < 0.3
True blacks with detail: frame lum_p5 <= 8 without the floor dropping below lum_median 20
Signs of life in the zone: a glass on a table, a record out of its sleeve, a coat on a chair
Delivered at full resolution (2400 x 1600) with no denoiser smear on the timber and wall

defects.what: End-grain wall reads as a camouflage Voronoi pattern under a regular square grid: procedural and tiled, no grain, no rings
Oxblood carpet is near-black murk (lum_median 14.7, range 18): no pile, no pools of light, the zone's colour is lost
Left timber wall is flat, uniformly striped CG wood with no checks or end grain; it reads as a veneer texture
Cabinet edges glow flat saturated red, edge clip 0.86 %, while the front faces show no reflections; reads as neon signage
Left speaker clip 1.18 %, the same flat neon edge glow
Horn above the right cabinet is a dark red smudge (lum_median 18.9): its silhouette is lost
Oak plinths are pale and raw (lum 50) and the brightest neutral in the frame; they read as unfinished pine boxes
Right plinth looks the same: pale, no grain at 1:1, slightly soft edges
An unreadable dark red mass at the frame's edge (a chair?) is crushed to lum_median 13.6
Milky lifted blacks (p1 10.6, nothing darker): a haze or denoise veil rather than night shadow; the 720 px proof is soft
Felt panels behind the speakers read as flat red rectangles with no texture

changes.problem: The frame is for the listening zone, but no tub chair, hex table or Orb is visible: it shows only the altar, like a product display.

evidence.measured: Bottom third has no readable furniture, lum_median 14.7; one crushed red mass at the right edge (lum 13.6)

change.to: position [11.2, 2.4, 1.05] (behind the back row of tub chairs, seated eye level), target [16.6, 3.05, 1.0], 28 mm, focus on the nearest Orb table at about 2.5 m, f/2.8; frame two chair backs and one lit Orb table in the foreground third, with the altar on the upper two thirds

changes.expected: The zone reads as a room of seats facing the speakers: chairs and an Orb pool in the foreground, the pair beyond, the frame specific to this place.

changes.problem: The oxblood carpet and chairs are lost in black murk, so the zone's one saturated colour does not read and there are no pools of light.
changes.expected: A warm pool around each table on the carpet and the velvet, falling off to shadow between tables; the carpet shows as oxblood wool.

changes.problem: The speakers are outlined only by their own glow; the horns and front faces get no light from the room, so the hero's silhouette breaks at the top.

evidence.measured: Horn lum_median 18.9; cabinet region [540,180,670,350] lum_median 40.6 (below the 45 target)

change.to: 160.0 W, cone 28.0 deg, 2500 K, aimed at the horn mouth so the cone covers the horn and the upper cabinet with its edge falling on the plinth

changes.expected: The horns' rims and the cabinets' fronts catch warm highlights, the silhouette reads at a glance, and a soft pool falls on the plinths and the carpet in front.

changes.problem: The cabinet edges glow flat, saturated neon red and clip, which reads as signage and not as polished thick acrylic.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 1.18 (left), 0.86 (right [540,180,670,350]); p95 about 175 with flat edge colour

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area

changes.expected: The edges glow with a gradient rather than a flat outline, the white batts show through the tint, and clipping drops, while c3 carries the front faces.

changes.problem: The end-grain niche reads as a camouflage texture under a square grid: obviously procedural, no growth rings or checks.

evidence.measured: Crop at 3x shows large Voronoi patches spanning many blocks, independent of the block grid; lum_range 23

change.from: large-scale cell noise across the wall
change.to: per-block random tone (plus or minus 10 % value, slight hue shift toward brown) with concentric ring texture and radial checks within each block, roughness 0.75, and the cell noise removed

changes.expected: Each block reads as a separate piece of oak end grain at about 50-100 mm scale; the wall becomes a warm, textured brown field behind the speakers.

changes.problem: The oak plinths are the palest neutral in the frame and read as raw pine boxes, competing with the speakers.

change.to: fumed / smoked oak, about 35 % darker, satin oil sheen (roughness 0.45) so the spot catches the top edge

changes.expected: The plinths sit darker than the cabinets, with grain and a lit top edge; the speaker becomes the brightest object.

changes.problem: The blacks are milky (nothing below about 10), so the frame looks veiled rather than like night shadow holding detail.

change.from: haze 0.01 per metre, look 'AgX - Medium High Contrast', exposure 1.6
change.to: haze 0.004 per metre, look 'AgX - High Contrast', exposure 1.75 (to hold the midtones as the black point drops)

changes.expected: Deep shadows with true black at the floor's far edges and in the corners; midtones held; the pools of light gain contrast.

changes.problem: The zone has no sign of life; it reads as an empty showroom.

evidence.measured: Visual: no glass, record or coat anywhere in the zone

change.from: props at the counter only (glasses, coat, candles)
change.to: add to the zone: a rocks glass and a record sleeve on the nearest Orb table, a coat or scarf over a tub chair's arm, a record out of its sleeve leaning against a plinth

changes.expected: Small highlights on glass and vinyl in the Orb's pool; the room looks occupied a moment ago.

out_of_scope.request: Show one speaker rather than two identical red cabinets (the brief's 'one speaker' reads, and the repeated copies look like a render)
out_of_scope.why: The Ember pair on the altar is fixed by the card; reframing (c1) with toe-in and depth will make them read as a pair, not as copies

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the saturation of the red felt panels and the speaker tint so the frame is not a single red wash
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour and the zone's oxblood are fixed by the room's design and EARF's products

out_of_scope.request: Replace the gridded end-grain niche with plaster or concrete to calm the background
out_of_scope.why: The niche lining is part of the room's design; only its finish (c5) may change
